subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should OpenClaw expose a caller-selected silent completion mode for `sessions_spawn`, and should that remain per-spawn or also become an `agents.defaults.subagents` setting?
rationale: Current main already protects the core safety concern by putting completion content through the requester agent, but silence changes the public completion contract, lifecycle bookkeeping, and configuration surface.

options.title: Add a per-spawn silent mode
options.body: Add one backward-compatible `sessions_spawn` completion mode that suppresses the parent handoff for that run while retaining cleanup and defaulting to the current parent-reviewed behavior.

options.title: Add per-spawn and default policy
options.body: Expose the narrow per-spawn mode plus a documented agent-default setting for users who need all subagent completions silent by policy.

options.title: Keep parent handoff only
options.body: Treat current requester-agent handoff as the supported safety boundary and decline an additional deterministic silence contract.

recommendation.title: Add a per-spawn silent mode
recommendation.body: Add one backward-compatible `sessions_spawn` completion mode that suppresses the parent handoff for that run while retaining cleanup and defaulting to the current parent-reviewed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical ownership trail covers the original spawn and announce lifecycle, while the decision concerns the permanent public contract for that surface.
